title: Actions Happening Now
introduction: Describe what someone is doing right now.
definition: Describe what someone is doing right now.
rules: Use am, is or are followed by a verb ending in -ing.
Some verbs change spelling before -ing: run becomes running.

exercises.question: He is ___. (run or running)
exercises.solution: Use the -ing form and double the final n in run.

exercises.question: We are ___ a cake. (make or making)
exercises.solution: Drop the final silent e before -ing.

exercises.question: Complete: ___ you listening?
exercises.solution: Move are before you to form a question.

summary: Describe what someone is doing right now. Use am, is or are followed by a verb ending in -ing.
